summary: All 7 WP-007 test cases (T1–T7) confirmed passing individually via `vitest run --reporter=verbose`. Full suite: 1750 tests, 0 failures. TypeScript compiles cleanly (tsc --noEmit). summary: Updated mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md to reflect the active_pipeline_stages scoping introduced across WP-002–WP-005 and the PM routing fix from WP-006. Each of the five affected handoff function descriptions (getDeveloperHandoff, getQaHandoff, getReviewerHandoff, getDocumentationHandoff, getProjectManagerHandoff) now documents their scope filter explicitly: which variable name (implWps/qaWps/reviewWps/docWps) is used, which steps are scoped vs. unscoped, and the ?? DEFAULT_PIPELINE_STAGES fallback for backward compatibility. The getProjectManagerHandoff step 2 description now correctly documents the PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP[firstActiveStage()] routing for unassigned READY WPs instead of the former hardcoded READY_FOR_DEVELOPER. CTX context files regenerated via node scripts/cli.js ctx-generate. WP-007 itself (test-only change to auto-handoff.test.ts) required no additional documentation — confirmed by Reviewer handoff note.

comments.note: The previous per-WP documentation passes (WP-001 through WP-006) each correctly determined no changes were needed in isolation. However, the combined behavioral changes across WP-002–WP-006 constitute a meaningful update to how the five handoff functions are documented: the api-surface.md algorithm comments no longer matched the implementation. This WP-007 documentation pass addresses the gap as a whole.
